2nd April 1937, 


My dear Bourne, 

I should be grateful for any information which 
you may be able to obtain regarding one Carl Heinrich Schlachter 
and his wife, Daisy Louise. 

Schlachter and his rife are U.S. citizens of 12, 
Crestmont Road, Montclair, New Jersey, who obtained British 
Empire-wide visas to sail in the s.s. "Franconia" on a world 
cruise. The visa includes a visit to India between the 26th 
February and 9th March 1937, but on the boat's arrival at 
Bombay they were not noticed on board. Further information 
states that they applied for accommodation in this ship from 
Yongekong to Kobe. 

Schlachter 1s the holder of passport No. 354944 
dated 30.11.36 bearing visa No.36049, He is described as a 
mechnical engineer, born in Germany on the 27th December 1873, 
His wife is the holder of passport No. 354945 dated 30.11.36. 
bearing visa No.36050 which shows her to have been born in New 
York on the 13th April 1885, 

As Schlachter is known to have been active some 
years ago in the Communist Strike at Botany Bay any information 


would be of value. 


Yours Sincerely, 


Major K.M. Bourne M.C., 


Shanghai Municipal Police,

April 18 37.

My dear Hill,

With reference to your letter dated
2nd April, 1937, I have to inform you that
neither Carl Heinrich Schlachter nor his wife,
Daisy Louise Schlachter, were on board the s.s.
"Franconia" when she arrived at Shanghai on
April 9, 1937. Enquiries show that although
Schlachter and his wife made provisional bookings
at the offices of the Cunard White Star Company
in New York in June, 1936, they did not confirm
their reservations and did not sail with the
s.s. "Franconia" when she set out on her world
cruise.

Yours sincerely,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.

F. L. Hill, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.

亲爱的希尔：

关于您1937年4月2日的来信，兹告知，卡尔·海因里希·施拉赫特（Carl Heinrich Schlachter）及其妻子黛西·路易丝·施拉赫特（Daisy Louise Schlachter）均未在1937年4月9日抵达上海的“弗兰科尼亚”号（s.s. "Franconia"）轮船上。经查，虽然施拉赫特夫妇曾于1936年6月在纽约的冠达白星轮船公司（Cunard White Star Company）办事处进行了临时预订，但他们并未确认预订，因此在该船启程进行环球巡航时并未随船出行。

此致，

（签名）K. M. 伯恩。

F. L. 希尔先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆。

REPORT
7866
Date April 11, 1937

Subject (in full) C.H. Schlachter, Communication from British
Consulate-General.

Made by D.P.S. Henchman Forwarded by J Boyne D S I

With reference to the attached communication, I
have to state that neither CARL HEINRICH SCHLACHTER nor his
wife DAISY LOUISE SCHLACHTER were aboard the s.s. "FRANCONIA"
when that vessel berthed at Shanghai on April 9, 1937.
Enquiries show that although Schlachter and his wife made
provisional bookings at the offices of the CUNARD WHITE STAR
Company in New York during June of 1936, they did not
confirm their reservations and did not sail with the s.s.
"Franconia" when she set out on her world cruise.

J Henchman
D. P. S.

cl.

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O.BOX 289. SHANGHAI.

SECRET. + Personal.

7866
2nd April 1937.

My dear Bourne,

I should be grateful for any information which
you may be able to obtain regarding one Carl Heinrich Schlachter
and his wife, Daisy Louise.

Schlachter and his wife are U.S. citizens of 12,
Crestmont Road, Montclair, New Jersey, who obtained British
Empire-wide visas to sail in the s.s. "Franconia" on a world
cruise. The visa includes a visit to India between the 26th
February and 9th March 1937, but on the boat's arrival at
Bombay they were not noticed on board. Further information
states that they applied for accommodation in this ship from
Hongkong to Kobe.

Schlachter is the holder of passport No. 354944
dated 30.11.36 bearing visa No.36049. He is described as a
mechnical engineer, born in Germany on the 27th December 1873.
His wife is the holder of passport No. 354945 dated 30.11.36.
bearing visa No.36050 which shows her to have been born in New
York on the 13th April 1885.

As Schlachter is known to have been active some
years ago in the Communist Strike at Botany Bay any information
would be of value.

Yours Sincerely,
〔签名〕

Major K.M. Bourne M.C.,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

D. P.S Henchman.
Il. 2/3

（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF POLICE SHANGHAI 2 APR. 1937）

机密。+ 私人。

7866
1937年4月2日。

亲爱的伯恩：

如蒙提供有关卡尔·海因里希·施拉赫特（Carl Heinrich Schlachter）及其妻子黛西·路易丝（Daisy Louise）的任何信息，不胜感激。

施拉赫特夫妇系美国公民，住址为新泽西州蒙特克莱尔市克雷斯特蒙特路12号（12, Crestmont Road, Montclair, New Jersey），他们获得了大英帝国全域签证，拟乘坐“弗兰科尼亚”号（s.s. "Franconia"）轮船进行环球巡航。该签证包括1937年2月26日至3月9日期间访问印度，但在该船抵达孟买时，并未发现他们在船上。进一步的信息指出，他们曾申请该船从香港至神户航段的舱位。

施拉赫特持有1936年11月30日签发的第354944号护照，签证号为36049。其身份描述为机械工程师，1873年12月27日出生于德国。其妻子持有1936年11月30日签发的第354945号护照，签证号为36050，显示其于1885年4月13日出生于纽约。

鉴于已知施拉赫特数年前曾在博特尼湾（Botany Bay）共产主义罢工活动中表现活跃，任何信息均有价值。

此致，
〔签名〕

K.M. 伯恩少校，M.C.勋衔，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

D. P.S. 亨奇曼。
Il. 2/3

（印：上海警务处处长办公室 1937年4月2日）
